title: 5th Sitting of Third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/5/3/2026).
Approval of the minutes of one previous sitting (minutes No. 28/2/2026).
Unfinished business: continuation of the debate on the Bill to amend the Criminal Procedure Act (Law No. 12/2016), submitted on behalf of the government by Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdooh.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to approve one set of old minutes and continue the debate on the government's bill amending the Criminal Procedure Act.
